## Research background at Aalto

My doctoral and postdoctoral research at Aalto University was supervised by [Weiwei Lin](https://people.aalto.fi/weiwei.lin). Related work by colleagues includes:

- [Rui Hao](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/rui-hao) — [Fatigue damage evaluation of cutout details in steel bridges](https://aaltodoc.aalto.fi/handle/123456789/123846).
- [Yifu Lan](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/yifu-lan) — [Algorithmic Advancements in Drive-by Inspection Methods Towards Intelligent Bridge Monitoring](https://aaltodoc.aalto.fi/handle/123456789/124189).
- [Pramod Acharya](https://www.aalto.fi/en/people/pramod-acharya-0) — Redundancy evaluation of bridge structures.
- [Mahmoud Hosseini](https://research.aalto.fi/en/persons/mahmoud-hosseini) — Robustness evaluation of bridge structures.
